name: light-rays
title: Light Rays
description: A component with animated light rays which shine down from above.

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the container (absolutely positioned to fill its parent).

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the rays and the ambient glow (any CSS colour; include some transparency).

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur of each ray in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds for one swing of a ray. Lower is faster.

props.name: length
props.description: Length of each ray, e.g. "70vh" or "500px".
